phrase: I'll follow up on this and get back to you by...
useCase: Committing to revisit a topic or provide additional information after the meeting
example: I don't have the exact figures right now, but I'll follow up on this and get back to you by end of day Thursday.
practicePrompt: A colleague asks you for data you don't have at hand. Promise to follow up using this phrase.

phrase: Let me circle back to the point you raised earlier.
useCase: Returning to a previously mentioned topic that was not fully addressed
example: Let me circle back to the point you raised earlier about vendor pricing. I've since checked with procurement.
practicePrompt: A topic was tabled earlier in the meeting. Return to it using this phrase.

phrase: I'll send out a summary of today's discussion.
useCase: Offering to document and distribute meeting notes or key takeaways
example: Great discussion, everyone. I'll send out a summary of today's discussion along with the action items by tomorrow morning.
practicePrompt: You just wrapped up a productive meeting. Offer to send a summary using this phrase.

phrase: Could you keep me in the loop on the progress of this?
useCase: Requesting ongoing updates about a project or task you are not directly managing
example: This initiative looks promising. Could you keep me in the loop on the progress of this as it develops?
practicePrompt: A teammate is leading a project that affects your department. Ask to be kept informed using this phrase.

phrase: Let's schedule a follow-up meeting to review the results.
useCase: Proposing a subsequent meeting to evaluate outcomes or continue an ongoing discussion
example: We've set the plan in motion. Let's schedule a follow-up meeting to review the results in two weeks.
practicePrompt: Your team has just agreed on a course of action. Propose a follow-up meeting using this phrase.

phrase: I wanted to touch base regarding our last conversation.
useCase: Reconnecting with someone about a topic discussed in a previous interaction
example: Hi Sarah, I wanted to touch base regarding our last conversation about the client onboarding process.
practicePrompt: You had a meeting with a colleague last week. Follow up with them using this phrase.

phrase: Just checking in to see where we stand on...
useCase: Casually following up on the status of a task, decision, or project
example: Just checking in to see where we stand on the contract renewal. Do we have an update from legal?
practicePrompt: A task was assigned a week ago and you haven't heard back. Check in using this phrase.

phrase: I'll make sure the action items are tracked and shared with the team.
useCase: Taking responsibility for documenting and distributing action items after a meeting
example: Thanks for the productive session. I'll make sure the action items are tracked and shared with the team by end of day.
practicePrompt: You volunteered to be the meeting note-taker. Commit to tracking action items using this phrase.

phrase: Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
useCase: Encouraging colleagues to contact you for clarification after a meeting or email
example: I've attached the revised project timeline. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
practicePrompt: You've just shared a detailed document with your team. Invite questions using this phrase.

phrase: I'll loop in the relevant stakeholders and keep you posted.
useCase: Committing to involve the right people and provide ongoing updates
example: This decision impacts the marketing team as well. I'll loop in the relevant stakeholders and keep you posted on their feedback.
practicePrompt: A decision was made that affects other departments. Commit to involving them using this phrase.
